# Ezekiel 21 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)
**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

**1** The LORD spoke to me again:

**2** "Son of man, face toward Jerusalem and speak out against the Temple. Prophesy against the land of Israel.

**3** Tell the land of Israel: The LORD says: I am your enemy! I will pull My sword from its sheath and cut down both the righteous and the wicked among you.

**4** Because I will cut down both righteous and wicked, My sword will come out of its sheath against everyone, from south to north.

**5** Then the whole world will know that I, the LORD, have drawn My sword. It will not go back into its sheath.

**6** So groan, son of man! Groan before their eyes with a broken heart and bitter anguish.

**7** When they ask, 'Why are you groaning?' tell them, 'Because of the news that's coming. When it arrives, every heart will melt, every hand will go limp, every spirit will faint, and every knee will buckle. It's coming — and it will happen,' declares the Lord GOD."

**8** The LORD spoke to me again:

**9** "Son of man, prophesy! Say: The LORD says — A sword! A sword! Sharpened and polished!

**10** Sharpened for the kill! Polished to flash like lightning! Should we celebrate? My people have scorned every other form of discipline.

**11** The sword is drawn, polished, and handed to the executioner. It gleams and flashes, ready for slaughter.

**12** The sword is drawn, polished, and handed to the executioner. It gleams and flashes, ready for slaughter.

**13** The sword is drawn, polished, and handed to the executioner. It gleams and flashes, ready for slaughter.

**14** So prophesy, son of man! Clap your hands. Let the sword strike twice, three times — the sword of mass slaughter, closing in from every side.

**15** The sword is drawn, polished, and handed to the executioner. It gleams and flashes, ready for slaughter.

**16** The sword is drawn, polished, and handed to the executioner. It gleams and flashes, ready for slaughter.

**17** The sword is drawn, polished, and handed to the executioner. It gleams and flashes, ready for slaughter.

**18** The sword is drawn, polished, and handed to the executioner. It gleams and flashes, ready for slaughter.

**19** Son of man, draw a map showing two roads for the king of Babylon's sword. Both roads start from the same country. Put up a signpost where the road forks toward the city.

**20** The sword is drawn, polished, and handed to the executioner. It gleams and flashes, ready for slaughter.

**21** The king of Babylon stands at the fork in the road, trying to decide which way to go. He shakes his arrows for a sign, consults his household idols, and examines a sheep's liver.

**22** The sword is drawn, polished, and handed to the executioner. It gleams and flashes, ready for slaughter.

**23** The sword is drawn, polished, and handed to the executioner. It gleams and flashes, ready for slaughter.

**24** The sword is drawn, polished, and handed to the executioner. It gleams and flashes, ready for slaughter.

**25** And as for you, you corrupt and wicked prince of Israel — your time is up. The day of final punishment has come.

**26** The Lord GOD says: Take off the crown! Remove the royal turban! Everything is about to change. The lowly will be exalted, and the exalted will be brought low.

**27** Ruin! Ruin! I will bring total ruin! The crown will not be restored until the One comes who has the right to it — and I will give it to Him.

**28** The sword is drawn, polished, and handed to the executioner. It gleams and flashes, ready for slaughter.

**29** The sword is drawn, polished, and handed to the executioner. It gleams and flashes, ready for slaughter.

**30** Put the sword back in its sheath! I will judge you in the land where you were born, the place where you were created.

**31** The sword is drawn, polished, and handed to the executioner. It gleams and flashes, ready for slaughter.

**32** You will be fuel for the fire. Your blood will soak into the ground. You will be forgotten — because I, the LORD, have spoken."

---
## PNEUMA's Meaning Notes

- **21:3-5**: God's sword won't distinguish between good and bad people. That's terrifying — and honest about what war actually does. Individual righteousness doesn't make you bulletproof in a national catastrophe.

- **21:21**: Here's the irony: Babylon's king is using pagan fortune-telling to decide which city to attack — and God is directing the results. God uses even pagan superstition to accomplish His plans.

- **21:27**: Three times: 'Ruin! Ruin! Ruin!' — the crown is being removed until the rightful king arrives. Christians see Jesus here. Jews see the Messiah. Either way, the point is clear: human kingship has failed, and someone better is coming.

— PNEUMA
